name: Watashi wa Roshutsu Dorei 2 Doko de mo Zenra Sarashimono
original_name: 私は露出奴隷2 どこでも全裸晒し者
source:
Airi the shy slave of lesbian lover Reina was forced to expose herself in public, over and over. These are her continued disgraces.

Enjoy the humiliation of Airi as she strips naked in the department store, retrieving a dropped handkerchief on the train, wears a microbikini and hands out cards in front of the station, gets on all fours like a dog naked in the park, jogs naked in front of club activity boys, attends school without a single garment of clothes... etc.
